comparison.objective: Pack a cold-chain shipper in safe layer order and, in later versions, latch its lid; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Record requires sequential placement of large components and spring-latch closure. Candidate requires small recessed-tool engagement, fine adjustment and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Record checks layer order, separation, flatness, lid seating/latching and withdrawal. Candidate checks repeated physical stopping and retained adjustment; some response thresholds are undeclared.
comparison.reason: Packing and enclosure closure do not test mechanical calibration.
